newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as TEM rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as TEM rates rise.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 492.00/493.00 bolivars per dollar after yields on benchmark six-month TEMs rose in Wednesday's regular Central Bank auction, traders said.
"The market was divided. Some were buying, some were selling, with most of the offered dollars stemming from the interbank market after the TEM auction results came in," said one broker.
Yields on six month TEMs rose 139 basis points to 20.93 percent from last week's yield of 19.54 percent.
Traders said the Central Bank sold some dollars in the morning. But "as the market was generally quiet ahead of the TEM auction, the bank did not need to sell much," said one.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
